subject.title: Feature: support message read action for Telegram

question: Should Telegram `message read` expose only gateway-observed messages, and what default action gate and retention policy should control that retained content?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the permanent behavior decides how Telegram group content is stored, authorized, exposed, and documented.

options.title: Observed-only, default-off read
options.body: Add a bounded observed-message read path behind an explicit Telegram action gate and document that it cannot fetch arbitrary historical Telegram messages.

options.title: Observed-only, default-on read
options.body: Expose observed reads for already-configured Telegram chats by default, accepting a broader upgrade-time privacy change.

options.title: Defer to archive hook direction
options.body: Keep the issue open until the passive history/plugin hook design lands, then build `message read` on that contract.

recommendation.title: Observed-only, default-off read
recommendation.body: Add a bounded observed-message read path behind an explicit Telegram action gate and document that it cannot fetch arbitrary historical Telegram messages.

likelyOwner.reason: He supplied the latest detailed review context and has adjacent message-tool/docs history for this decision surface.
